name: @shenron/koharu
description: Koharu manga translation engine client for Shenron: typed IPC protocol generated from koharu-app (Tauri Specta), the koharu-sdk JSON Lines transport and the wasm canvas.

scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build ../../crates/koharu-canvas --release --target web --out-dir ../../packages/koharu/src/wasm --out-name koharu_canvas --no-pack && bun scripts/prepare-wasm.ts
